terms.vat: All prices are exclusive of 5% VAT.
terms.quoteValidity: Quotations are valid for 1 month upon receipt.
terms.minimumGuests: A minimum of 12 guests is charged per event. Small-group fixed-price packages cover the published 10–15 guest tier. Premium menus and live stations start from 20 guests. Guest counts outside a listed tier are quoted individually.
terms.guestCount: The final number of guests must be advised 2 days prior to the event date. Any decrease in the number of guests will affect the price structure.
terms.eventDuration: Standard service duration is a maximum of four (4) hours per event, excluding set-up time. Full-day catering is not subject to the 4-hour limit but must be discussed, mutually agreed and confirmed in writing prior to the event date.
terms.foodDisplay: Food is to be consumed within 3 hours maximum upon display at the right temperature.
staffing: Standard staffing consists primarily of male service staff, with the possibility of mixed-gender teams depending on the schedule for the event date.
If a female server is specifically required, please inform us in advance; female staffing requests are subject to availability and may incur an additional charge.
Designated on-site live-station chefs consist exclusively of male kitchen staff.
All live station bookings require mandatory service staff allocation for full station set-up, guest service, replenishment and clearance.
terms.menuChanges: Clients may add, remove, replace or swap items according to their liking; replacing standard items with costlier items or adding items beyond the menu structure will affect the price structure.
multiStationDiscounts: Choose 2 live stations: 15% off the final quote.
Choose 3 live stations: 20% off the final quote.
Discounts exclude chef charges and VAT.
terms.governingLaw: This proposal is governed by the laws of the Emirate of Dubai and the United Arab Emirates; disputes are referred to Dubai Courts.
